Le Pet worked with us to decide on a suitable cut for her . I wanted it short so I wouldn’t have to return to groom anytime soon . What I really liked was that they didn’t push to shave her down . They were willing to take the time to brush her out if I wanted that . Normally , I would have had them keep as much length , but we are leaving town soon to a rural area where things would get stuck in her fur . I’m super happy with the results .
